description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder, verifying its behavior through various test cases.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder, testing various functionalities including setting, removing, nested object creation, and predicate-based modifications.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants such as keys, pointers, and fields used across the tests.

methods.name: createField
methods.description: Helper method to create a JsonField with specified key and string value.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up a fresh instance of ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder before each test.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementations of ImmutableJsonObjectBuilder using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToInvokeSetAllWithNullIterator
methods.description: Tests that calling setAll with null throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: setAllSetsAllSpecifiedFieldsWithoutDuplicates
methods.description: Checks that setAll adds all fields from the collection, removing duplicates.

methods.name: removeAllReturnsEmptyObject
methods.description: Tests that removeAll clears the builder to an empty state.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithEmptyKey
methods.description: Verifies that setting a value with an empty key throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that setting with a null JSON pointer throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithSlashString
methods.description: Tests that setting a value with a slash string as key throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setValueWithSlashAsJsonKey
methods.description: Checks that a key consisting of a slash can be used as a valid key.

methods.name: doNotSetFieldIfPredicateEvaluatesToFalse
methods.description: Verifies that a field is not set if the predicate evaluates to false.

methods.name: doSetFieldIfPredicateEvaluatesToTrue
methods.description: Checks that a field is set if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: setWithJsonPointerWorksAsExpected1
methods.description: Tests nested object creation with JSON pointers, final structure expected to match explicitly built JSON.

methods.name: setWithJsonPointerWorksAsExpected2
methods.description: Tests setting multiple fields at different pointers, verifying proper merge and structure.

methods.name: setWithJsonPointerWorksAsExpected3
methods.description: Tests replacing a JSON value with a boolean using pointer, ensuring correct override.

methods.name: setWithJsonPointerWorksAsExpected4
methods.description: Tests replacing null literal with an object and then setting nested value.

methods.name: setWithJsonPointerAndPredicateWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that setting with a predicate that returns false results in no change.

methods.name: removeWithJsonKeyWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that removing a JSON key works as intended.

methods.name: removeWithJsonPointerWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies removal of a nested object via JSON pointer, leading to expected JSON structure.

methods.name: removeWithEmptyStringDoesNothing
methods.description: Ensures that calling remove on an empty string key does not alter the builder.

methods.name: removeSlashOnlyKeyWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that removing a key which is a slash functions correctly.

methods.name: removePreviouslyAddedObjectByPointer
methods.description: Removes a nested object by pointer and verifies the nested value is empty afterward.

methods.name: setNestedObjectWithImplicitDefinition
methods.description: Tests setting nested objects using pointers with implicit field definitions.

methods.name: setFieldsWithPartialExcludeBasedOnFieldDefinition
methods.description: Checks that setting fields with specific definitions can exclude certain fields based on predicates.

methods.name: setIntValueWithPredicateWhichEvaluatesToTrue
methods.description: Verifies setting an integer value with a predicate that evaluates to true.
